evidence.combat_loop: H01 official recruit-to-automatic-combat description; H03 contemporary target and attack explanation
evidence.card_faces: H04 build 35747 card definitions; normal/golden stats and fixed deathrattle token faces in historical-card-pool.json and historical-fixed-token-nodes.json
evidence.simulator_comparison: H09 third-party simulator is an alternate implementation, not original event order

reference_decisions.snapshot: derive base attack and health from the 81-card table or a fixed-token definition; inject keyword tags with an evidence grade
reference_decisions.attacker_and_target: turn side and left-to-right cursor are tracked; caller injects a target, and a taunt target is mandatory when any enemy has taunt
reference_decisions.strike: calculate attack and counterattack from the pre-strike snapshot, apply primary then left/right cleave damage, then counterattack; divine shield blocks one damage instance
reference_decisions.poison: poisonous destroys only after effective positive damage; shield absorption does not trigger poison
reference_decisions.death: remove the simultaneous dead batch, then process fixed deathrattles in left/right and original-position order solely for deterministic reference
reference_decisions.summon: use existing fixed-token nodes, require caller-injected token damage tier, cap each destination board at seven, and retain a source-side manifest for lifecycle settlement
reference_decisions.unresolved_effects: fail closed when a source with a known but unsupported random or composite death effect dies, or a known unsupported attack effect attacks
reference_decisions.compiled_listeners: nine listener and multiplier nodes in historical-combat-listener-nodes.json run only in reference mode; combined or repeated multiplier sources fail closed
reference_decisions.compiled_auras: five fixed minion auras in historical-combat-aura-nodes.json recompute on snapshot, removal and summon; current health follows the aura delta, and subsequent death batches handle health collapse
reference_decisions.compiled_shield_listener: a friendly shield-loss event immediately grows each surviving Bolvar in board order; retaliation still uses its pre-strike attack snapshot
reference_decisions.compiled_zapp: BGS_022 uses an explicit pending second strike, reevaluates the lowest current enemy attack for each strike, rejects Taunt conflicts and requires a graded injected choice for equal minima; this is a reference transition only
reference_decisions.compiled_attack_effects: TRL_232 compares positive effective primary damage against pre-hit health and summons its candidate token after the bounded death batch; OG_300 grows only when its own attack kills the primary target and it survives; dying sources reject unresolved order
reference_decisions.compiled_death_buffs: OG_256 buffs all surviving friendlies and BGS_018 buffs surviving friendly beasts after removal of the death batch; each surviving Baron repeats its source's buff per pass; all scheduling is reference-only
reference_decisions.compiled_kangor: track friendly mech deaths by strict batch, select the earliest two/four, and reanimate reference death snapshots; ambiguous same-batch order, repeated identity and Khadgar interaction fail closed
reference_decisions.compiled_original_cost_random: BGS_025, BGS_023 and BGS_024 use only caller-graded indexes into H09 community arrays; H05 verifies candidate card costs and base stats but not live eligibility; unsupported candidates and ambiguous batch or Khadgar interactions fail atomically
reference_decisions.compiled_legendary_random: BGS_006 uses a caller-graded H09 index and only the bounded BGS_029 and LOE_077 reference subset; H10 supports a contemporaneous count of 12 but no IDs; H05 client rarity does not establish live eligibility
reference_decisions.compiled_deathrattle_random: BGS_008 uses a caller-graded H09 index and only the bounded OG_256 and BGS_018 reference subset; H05 deathrattle tags do not establish live eligibility; generated candidates' compiled buff deathrattles remain reference-only
reference_decisions.compiled_adapt_nonstat: typed BGS_031 option grants from the recruitment reducer enter combat snapshots with reference_injected grade; Taunt, Divine Shield, Poisonous, Windfury, and Stealth use bounded attack rules, each Living Spores grant summons two 1/1 Plants with injected damage tier, and spell/hero-power untargetability is preserved without blocking minion attacks
reference_decisions.adapt_repeat_and_expiry: duplicate Windfury and other keywords are idempotent in combat, duplicate Living Spores grants each summon two Plants, and temporary Stealth grants are removed on the next advance_round; this is a reference-only design, not original event-order evidence
reference_decisions.adapt_fail_closed: forged adapted keywords, all-enemy-Stealth target choice, missing Plant damage tier, multiple adapted spore deaths in one batch, and unresolved native/adapt deathrattle ordering reject atomically
reference_decisions.uncompiled_live_passives: Mal'Ganis hero immunity is handled only by the bounded recruit-damage and terminal-result lifecycle node
reference_decisions.bridge: a terminal battle emits the survivor IDs and all generated-instance manifests accepted by historical-combat-lifecycle.json
